evidence: Existing shared password validation and hash verification are reused, including minimum eight characters.
Password hash and credential/MFA generation are compared under transaction before mutation.

findings.result: Independent followup190 code review reported no blocker; no new test execution by reviewer.
evidence: Client upload/send guard exists at HTTP before admission/body, service, store and append layers; reuse of old video ID is denied.

findings.result: Previously reported concrete issues were corrected by photos190 and reread; tests cited are agent-reported.
evidence: Upload/send stops at first failure and retries stable contiguous prefix, preserving preview order and first-photo caption.

Caption-delivered tracking prevents duplicate caption on final failed-item removal.
Gallery uses canonical date/message-ID ordering and scoped sequence pivot.
Reply watermark is captured before batch prepare/upload and retained across retries.
